name: kq-person-update-own-profile
description: Call tool 'ciq_execute' with arguments: id: "<this query's id>", input_params: {new_music_mood: (required) new music_mood value, new_dance_skill: (required) new dance_skill value}. Auth: Bearer token required (Person subject), the token 'sub' identifies the Person whose properties are updated. Returns: the updated music_mood and dance_skill on the Person.
